title: Solvent cementing.
officialText:
Joint surfaces shall be clean and free from moisture. A purple primer that conforms to ASTM F 656
shall be applied. Solvent cement not purple in color and conforming to ASTM D 2564, CSA B 137.3, CSA B 181.2 or CSA B
182.1 shall be applied to all joint surfaces. The joint shall be made while the cement is wet and shall be in accordance with ASTM
D 2855. Solvent-cement joints shall be permitted above or below ground.
